# Reproducible verification in R

## Learning objective
Make every verification step traceable.

## Content to develop
- Record input provenance and data dictionaries.
- Record software versions, commands, and random seeds where relevant.
- Compare independently obtained results with the supplied output.
- Record discrepancies without silently modifying original evidence.

## Practice task
Plan the checks needed to reproduce a supplied result. Case-specific executable checks will be added during development.

## Checkpoint
Can another reader trace each conclusion to evidence and understand what remains uncertain?

## Deliverable
A verification plan and environment record.

::: {.callout-note}
## Authoring status
Chapter outline ready. Add a worked example, learner instructions, verified outputs where applicable, and a collapsible explanation before release.
:::
